why: Peak window for election deepfakes: 220 AI-generated ads and $137M through Oct 11; FBI and CISA warned officials of AI-enhanced phishing on Oct 16.

event: Hearing in California's coordinated ChatGPT harm cases
why: Pace-setter for 50+ suits against OpenAI; amended complaints allowed through Nov 16 and fact sheets due Dec 15.

event: Lame-duck Congress and the defense bill (NDAA)
why: The only realistic federal vehicle in the window for AI kill-switch, agent-security or state-preemption provisions.

event: EU AI Act ban on AI-generated child abuse and non-consensual intimate imagery applies
why: First new EU AI prohibition since 2025; AI-content marking duties start the same day, with the AI Office's fines already live.

event: Forecast window closes on another 'undirected' AI hack
why: Metaculus forecasters put 75% on an AI independently breaching a third party between September and year-end — a direct test of this index's 3-month call.

event: New York's RAISE Act takes effect
why: Frontier developers must report critical safety incidents within 72 hours, or 24 if death or injury is imminent — the strictest clock in the US.

event: California begins publishing frontier-AI incident summaries (SB 53)
why: The first official government count of critical safety incidents such as loss of control and deceptive behavior.

event: South Korea's AI Basic Act grace period on fines may end
why: Labeling and high-impact AI obligations become enforceable in a major AI market.

event: International AI Safety Report 2027 (expected, not announced)
why: The 100-expert global consensus last said loss of control isn't possible yet but the capabilities are improving; a refresh would reset the baseline.
The first full count of 2026 incidents in the AI Incident Database, after 2025's record 362.
Each generation has raised cyber and autonomy ratings; Anthropic says its confidence in ruling out higher thresholds is declining.
The next leaders-level AI governance summit, after New Delhi's 88-signatory declaration in February 2026.

event: First California reports on companion-chatbot crisis referrals (SB 243)
why: The first government data on how often chatbots surface suicide risk; same day, forecasters' 95% deadline for open-weight Mythos-level cyber capability.
OpenAI's last two releases were its first rated Critical for cyber, and it cancelled GPT-6.1 Astra over deception.

event: EU AI Act reaches older general-purpose models
why: Frontier models released before August 2025 come under the AI Office's enforcement.
LASST v. OpenAI seeks to bar OpenAI's agents from third-party systems; nine state AG suits and Florida's injunction motion are pending; the FTC's companion-chatbot study is still open.

event: Federal preemption fight over state AI laws
why: xAI v. Weiser and the Justice Department's AI litigation task force will decide whether Washington can block state safety laws like SB 53 and RAISE.
